question: Should OpenClaw adopt this experimental cross-repository Claws contract—one package creating one new agent with grouped ownership and a shared experimental gate—as the direction for the listed implementation stacks?
rationale: The remaining question is whether this product and compatibility surface should exist and be governed this way; documentation edits cannot safely decide that policy for OpenClaw and ClawHub.

options.title: Adopt the experimental contract
options.body: Accept the agent-centric, gated RFC as the product boundary for the staged OpenClaw and ClawHub implementation work.

options.title: Narrow the contract first
options.body: Request a smaller initial scope, such as grouped JSON only or fewer lifecycle owners, before accepting a portable package specification.

options.title: Defer the direction
options.body: Leave the RFC open until core and registry owners have capacity and agreement to sponsor the cross-repository rollout.

recommendation.title: Adopt the experimental contract
recommendation.body: Accept the agent-centric, gated RFC as the product boundary for the staged OpenClaw and ClawHub implementation work.

likelyOwner.reason: Their detailed review established the central agent model and schema constraints now embodied by the proposal.
